items.notes: The homarid makes two claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). The homarid has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The homarid can breathe air and water.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

items.name: Pounce
items.notes: If the kavu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kavu can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Lyra's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). Lyra can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Lyra makes two melee attacks.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

items.name: Healing Touch
items.notes: Lyra touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

items.name: Angelic Weapons
items.notes: Lyra's weapon attacks are magical. When Lyra hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

items.name: Divine Awareness
items.notes: Lyra knows if it hears a lie.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Lyra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The angel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The angel makes two melee attacks.

items.name: Mace
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

items.name: Healing Touch
items.notes: The angel touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

items.name: Change Shape
items.notes: The angel magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the angel's choice). In a new form, the angel retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

items.name: Angelic Weapons
items.notes: The angel's weapon attacks are magical. When the angel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Shalai's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Shalai makes two greatsword attacks.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.

items.name: Slaying Longbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.

items.name: Flying Sword
items.notes: Shalai releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If Shalai can see the sword, Shalai can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 feet and either make one attack against a target or return to Shalai's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, Shalai is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if Shalai dies.

items.name: Healing Touch
items.notes: Shalai touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

items.name: Angelic Weapons
items.notes: Shalai's weapon attacks are magical. When Shalai hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

items.name: Divine Awareness
items.notes: Shalai knows if it hears a lie.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Shalai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Shalai magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

items.name: Searing Burst
items.notes: Shalai emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Blinding Gaze
items.notes: Shalai targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) slashing damage.

items.name: Raking Charge
items.notes: If the kavu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kavu can make one rend attack against it as a bonus action.

name: Zombie Horse
languages: understands all languages it spoke in life but can't speak

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Undead Fortitude
items.notes: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
